name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, spending countless hours building model cars and dreaming of technical innovation. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he landed an entry-level position at a local aerodynamics firm, focusing primarily on wind tunnel operations. While still relatively new to the field, Alistair is a dedicated and detail-oriented operator, known for his precision and commitment to data accuracy. He’s eager to learn from experienced engineers and contribute to improved vehicle performance through meticulous testing and analysis.

His pragmatic approach is perfectly suited to the demanding nature of wind tunnel work, where precision and a keen eye for detail are paramount. Alistair thrives in environments that demand accuracy and structured processes. He is committed to mastering his craft and becoming an indispensable member of a high-performing team. Alistair's loyalty and drive make him a valuable asset to any team looking to enhance their aerodynamic capabilities.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side parting.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a lean build, and always wears safety glasses in the wind tunnel.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to record observations.
Has a habit of double-checking every instrument calibration before each run.
Enjoys listening to classical music through noise-cancelling headphones while working.
